05. Visualisasi Spasial Folium: Peta Ground Truth Aktual#

Rekonstruksi Poligon Convex Hull dan Peta Interaktif Bebas Pemblokiran#

Notebook ini merekonstruksi geometri poligon sampel dari file piksel Sentinel-2A menggunakan GeoPandas (dissolve dan convex_hull), mengaitkan dengan status split latih/uji serta nilai rata-rata indeks spektral, kemudian memvisualisasikannya ke dalam Folium Map dengan basemap Google Maps, Google Satellite, dan Esri World Imagery (bebas blokir HTTP 403).

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import geopandas as gpd
import folium

BASE_DIR = Path.cwd()
DATA_DIR = BASE_DIR / "data"
OUT_DIR = BASE_DIR / "output"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

DATA_FILE = DATA_DIR / "piksel_s2.csv"
SPLIT_FILE = OUT_DIR / "df_poligon_split.csv"

if not DATA_FILE.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"File {DATA_FILE} tidak ditemukan!")

if not SPLIT_FILE.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"File {SPLIT_FILE} belum tersedia! Jalankan notebook '03_data_preparation.ipynb' terlebih dahulu."
    )

print("Memuat dataset piksel dan metadata poligon...")
df_pix = pd.read_csv(DATA_FILE)
df_poly_meta = pd.read_csv(SPLIT_FILE)
print(f"Piksel: {len(df_pix):,}, Poligon: {len(df_poly_meta)}")

Memuat dataset piksel dan metadata poligon...

Piksel: 613,282, Poligon: 357

1. Rekonstruksi Poligon Menggunakan GeoPandas Dissolve & Convex Hull#

Mengonversi titik-titik koordinat piksel menjadi GeoDataFrame, lalu menggabungkan (dissolve) berdasarkan poligon_id dan membentuk poligon terluar (convex hull).

gdf_points = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    df_pix,
    geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(df_pix.lon, df_pix.lat),
    crs="EPSG:4326"
)

# Dissolve dan Convex Hull
polygons = gdf_points.dissolve(by='poligon_id', aggfunc='first').reset_index()
polygons['geometry'] = polygons['geometry'].convex_hull
polygons = polygons[~polygons['geometry'].is_empty].copy()

# Gabungkan dengan metadata split dan rata-rata indeks dari df_poly_meta
cols_to_merge = ['poligon_id', 'split', 'NDVI', 'NDWI', 'MNDWI', 'NDBI']
polygons = polygons.drop(columns=[c for c in cols_to_merge if c in polygons.columns and c != 'poligon_id'])
polygons = polygons.merge(df_poly_meta[cols_to_merge], on='poligon_id', how='left')

print(f"Poligon berhasil direkonstruksi: {len(polygons)} geometri poligon.")
display(polygons[['poligon_id', 'label_teks', 'split', 'NDVI', 'geometry']].head())

2. Membangun Peta Interaktif Folium Bebas Blokir#

Menggunakan basemap terpercaya tanpa API key dan tanpa batasan CORS/403:

  • Default: Google Maps Standard (https://mt1.google.com/vt/lyrs=m&x={x}&y={y}&z={z})

  • Layer 1: Google Satellite (https://mt1.google.com/vt/lyrs=s&x={x}&y={y}&z={z})

  • Layer 2: Esri World Imagery (https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x})

  • Satu FeatureGroup per kelas tutupan lahan untuk kemudahan kontrol layer.

colors = {
    'Sawah': '#FFD92F',
    'Bangunan': '#E41A1C',
    'Hutan': '#2E7D32',
    'Danau': '#4FC3F7',
    'Laut': '#0D47A1',
    'Mangrove': '#8E44AD'
}

map_center = [df_pix['lat'].mean(), df_pix['lon'].mean()]
m = folium.Map(
    location=map_center,
    zoom_start=9,
    tiles='https://mt1.google.com/vt/lyrs=m&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}',
    attr='Google Maps'
)

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles='https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
    attr='Esri World Imagery',
    name='Esri Satellite',
    overlay=False,
    control=True
).add_to(m)

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles='https://mt1.google.com/vt/lyrs=s&x={x}&y={y}&z={z}',
    attr='Google Satellite',
    name='Google Satellite',
    overlay=False,
    control=True
).add_to(m)

# FeatureGroup per kelas aktual
feature_groups = {}
for label in ['Sawah', 'Bangunan', 'Hutan', 'Danau', 'Laut', 'Mangrove']:
    fg = folium.FeatureGroup(name=f"Aktual: {label}", show=True)
    feature_groups[label] = fg
    m.add_child(fg)

# Tambahkan poligon ke peta
for idx, row in polygons.iterrows():
    label_str = str(row['label_teks'])
    color = colors.get(label_str, '#333333')
    
    tooltip_html = (
        f"<b>{label_str}</b> (ID: {row['poligon_id']})<br>"
        f"Split: <b>{row.get('split', '-')}</b><br>"
        f"NDVI: {row.get('NDVI', 0):.3f} | NDWI: {row.get('NDWI', 0):.3f}"
    )
    
    popup_html = folium.Popup(
        f"<div style='font-family: Arial; font-size: 12px; width: 200px;'>"
        f"<h4 style='margin: 0 0 5px 0; color: {color};'>{label_str}</h4>"
        f"<b>Poligon ID:</b> {row['poligon_id']}<br>"
        f"<b>Status Split:</b> {row.get('split', '-')}<br>"
        f"<b>NDVI:</b> {row.get('NDVI', 0):.3f}<br>"
        f"<b>NDWI:</b> {row.get('NDWI', 0):.3f}<br>"
        f"<b>MNDWI:</b> {row.get('MNDWI', 0):.3f}<br>"
        f"<b>NDBI:</b> {row.get('NDBI', 0):.3f}<br>"
        f"</div>",
        max_width=250
    )
    
    try:
        folium.GeoJson(
            data=row['geometry'].__geo_interface__,
            style_function=lambda x, c=color: {
                'fillColor': c,
                'color': c,
                'weight': 1.5,
                'fillOpacity': 0.7
            },
            tooltip=tooltip_html,
            popup=popup_html
        ).add_to(feature_groups[label_str])
    except Exception as e:
        pass

# Legenda HTML
legend_html = '''
<div style="position: fixed; 
     bottom: 30px; left: 30px; width: 170px; height: 190px; 
     background-color: white; border:2px solid #bbb; z-index:9999; font-size:12px;
     padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);">
     <p style="margin:0 0 8px 0; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd; padding-bottom: 4px;">Kelas Aktual (LULC)</p>
     <i style="background: #FFD92F; width: 12px; height: 12px; float: left; margin-right: 8px; border: 1px solid #888;"></i> Sawah<br>
     <i style="background: #E41A1C; width: 12px; height: 12px; float: left; margin-right: 8px; border: 1px solid #888;"></i> Bangunan<br>
     <i style="background: #2E7D32; width: 12px; height: 12px; float: left; margin-right: 8px; border: 1px solid #888;"></i> Hutan<br>
     <i style="background: #4FC3F7; width: 12px; height: 12px; float: left; margin-right: 8px; border: 1px solid #888;"></i> Danau<br>
     <i style="background: #0D47A1; width: 12px; height: 12px; float: left; margin-right: 8px; border: 1px solid #888;"></i> Laut<br>
     <i style="background: #8E44AD; width: 12px; height: 12px; float: left; margin-right: 8px; border: 1px solid #888;"></i> Mangrove<br>
</div>
'''
m.get_root().html.add_child(folium.Element(legend_html))
folium.LayerControl(collapsed=False).add_to(m)

# Simpan peta ke HTML
berkas_peta = OUT_DIR / "peta_aktual_lulc.html"
m.save(str(berkas_peta))
print(f"Peta aktual LULC tersimpan di: {berkas_peta.resolve()}")
print(f"Ukuran berkas: {berkas_peta.stat().st_size:,} bytes")
print("=== DAFTAR BERKAS KELUARAN NOTEBOOK 05 ===")
print(f"- {berkas_peta.name}")
